body:
Adds `research/precision-scores`: scoring a verifier's vector report (expected drift, one coordinate per layer).

- Quadratic Bregman scores are proper; the per-task gap against a trusted reference has exact mean `DᵀAD` and variance `4DᵀAΣAD` for any noise law.
- Cauchy–Schwarz: `A = Σ⁻¹` is uniformly most detectable among quadratic scores.
- Isotropic scores have efficiency ≥ `4κ/(1+κ)²` (Kantorovich); 25× more tasks at κ=100 (power 0.29 vs 0.80 at 48 tasks).
- Estimated-precision efficiency vs number of reference draws.
- Stdlib-only, 7 tests, white paper, README and portfolio entries.
